events.title: Weekly Ramen
events.description: Come join us weekly (excluding week 6) on Thursdays 1-3pm at Colombo Theatres Foyer for some free ramen!

events.title: Ibi's Chill Lounge
events.description: Our weekly hangout session, where you can socialise with fellow AUNSW members, participate in craft activities and more!

events.title: Anisyd Art Mart
events.description: In partnership with Anime Manga Artists Australia (AMAA), we present a TWO-day (16th & 17th) Anime/Train-themed Artist Market full of fun prizes, cosplays, and activities, sponsored by SMASH! With over 100 wonderful artists, tickets are gonna run out soon so make sure to get your tickets early!

events.title: Cosplay Casino
events.description: The fourth instalment of one of our most popular collabs - the Cosplay Casino with TTG Soc! You are encouraged to cosplay, and will enter a special cosplay raffle if you do! Come along to wear your favourite cosplay, play some casino games, and win some prizes! There's even free pizza!
events.imageAlt: AnimeUNSW x TTGSoc Cosplay Casino Banner

events.title: Ita Bag Meetup
events.description: Join SanrioSoc and AUNSW for our ita bag meet up! A fun afternoon to show off your ita bags, celebrate your favourite characters, and meet fellow fans!
events.imageAlt: AnimeUNSW x SanrioSoc Ita Bag Meetup Banner

events.title: Anisyd Welcome Party
events.description: Join the biggest anime societies in Sydney for a night of anime-themed games and challenges. Each society hosts various games and activities, an amazing opportunity to meet like-minded people from other universities. There are even two SMASH! Con tickets up for grabs for the winners of the cosplay competition!

events.title: AUNSW Mooting
events.description: In this courtroom, you will compete in a simulated court setting in teams of 3-4. You will argue for or against a specific anime prompt while completing challenges. The jury will be the audience, and there are even some prizes up for grabs for the best lawyers!

events.title: Kickoff 2026
events.description: AUNSW's annual welcome event! Hundreds of anime fans come together to make new friends, test their anime knowledge in a competition, and show off their favourite cosplays in our cosplay competition!

events.title: Spicy Ramen Challenge
events.description: After fun icebreakers that will help you meet like-minded anime fans, prepare to meet Ibi's spicy concoction if you sign up below! Only the best of the best will make it through to the final round. But other than a unique speedfriending experience, what else is in it for you? We have some great prizes up for grabs, so come and try to win!

events.title: That Time I Went Questing In Another World
events.description:
You wake up to find yourself transported into another world🌀. You scramble to your feet—only to realize you're not alone.👥 Strangers, cosplayers, surround you, all just as lost, just as confused😰. Then you hear a voice, it echoes through the darkness. Cold. Regal. And otherworldly…

“ Welcome, Players. ”

The mysterious king has summoned you for his immersive game🃏. The rules? Deceptively simple. Complete your quests. Earn points📝. But here's the twist: only one can claim victory🏆 . Only one gets to go home. Will that one be you?
